messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — partnering ISV (GlueLayer) wants a self-serve sandbox + LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter onramp. Can we sync requirements?

mira: Awesome, thx. Primary asks: sandbox workspace, sample dataset, connector adapter, and a quickstart demo for customers.

sanjay: Do we have a recommended env for the sandbox? GPU or CPU only?

elaine: For initial trials CPU is fine (cost). We'll offer a GPU plan for performance tests. Need a toggle in the UI to request GPU.

rob: Integration checklist idea: 1) adapter cert, 2) quickstart app, 3) smoke tests, 4) usage quotas, 5) joint co-marketing assets.

mira: +1. Also need a joint announcement plan and embargo dates. GlueLayer wants a soft demo by Apr 10 and public blurb Apr 20.

kevin: FYI infra constraints: sandbox buckets must be isolated per partner. Need an onboarding ticket to set up VPC/policy.

alex: Can engineering owners? @sanjay for runtime, @kevin for infra, @elaine for DX docs, @rob for partner PM.

sanjay: I can own runtime gating. I'll publish a minimal adapter pattern for LangChain and LlamaIndex in our repo and a dockerized example. ETA: 1 week.

elaine: I'll draft quickstart + sample prompts. Need a tiny dataset (5–10 docs) and a step-by-step for LangChain Chat + LlamaIndex retriever.

rob: Marketing: we'll align the co-announcement and assets after tech sign-off. Can we lock the demo date by EOD Friday?

mira: I'll confirm with GlueLayer and come back. If they accept Apr 10 demo we need certs by Apr 3.

dev-bot: New ticket created: PARTNERS-4123 — "GlueLayer sandbox onramp" (assignees: sanjay, kevin).

kevin: On infra — I'll provision partner bucket + sandbox role, and add a rate-limited API key generator. ETA 3 days.

sanjay: Adapter note for eng: prefer this pattern:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from langchain import LLMChain
# small adapter shim that maps RL requests -> LangChain prompts
```
Keep it tiny so partners can fork.

elaine: Acceptance criteria for launch:
- adapter repo + README
- reproducible quickstart demo (<10 mins)
- sandbox created and isolated
- smoke test passing (latency <500ms for sample prompts)

rob: Can product/legal confirm data handling language? Need addendum for sandbox telemetry.

mira: I'll loop in legal. Also suggest a short onboarding session (30m) for partner engineers on demo day.

kevin: Noted — adding a temporary shim role so they can spin up test instances without prod access.

alex: Great progress. Next steps: sanjay/kevin build, elaine docs, rob coordinate comms, mira confirm dates. Ping here with blockers. :rocket:

mira: Ping — GlueLayer confirmed demo Apr 11 actually. Shifting timeline 1 day.

rob: Ok adjust marketing timeline: embargo Apr 21. I'll update the calendar invite.

dev-bot: Ticket PARTNERS-4123 updated: status -> in_progress.

sanjay: One blocker: sample dataset needs to be scrubbed. Who owns that?

elaine: I'll take data scrub and generate the 10-doc sample with synthetic PII removed.

alex: Thanks team. Quick checklist update when each item done. :white_check_mark:
